verse.text: I am going where everyone on earth must someday go. Take courage and be a man. Observe the requirements of the Lord your God, and follow all his ways. Keep the decrees, commands, regulations, and laws written in the Law of Moses so that you will be successful in all you do and wherever you go.

video.title: Be Courageous: You Are Not Alone (Sermon Clip)

reflection: David didn't leave Solomon a five-year plan or a pep talk about success — he told him to be a man of courage who actually follows God's ways, day in and day out. That's the real job description for us too: not perfection, just showing up with backbone and obedience, especially when nobody's watching. Your kids won't remember your speeches nearly as much as they'll remember whether your life matched your words.
